name: pick_and_place
definition: Pick up and move one or more objects to a specified location without changing their object state.

name: clean_then_place
definition: Clean, wash, rinse, or dry an object and place it at a specified location, or simply leave it clean if no destination is given.

name: heat_then_place
definition: Heat, warm, or cook an object and place it at a specified location, or simply leave it heated if no destination is given.

name: cool_then_place
definition: Cool, chill, or refrigerate an object and place it at a specified location, or simply leave it cooled if no destination is given.

name: toggle_lamp_while_holding
definition: Pick up or hold an object and turn on a lamp.
